routing.name: Queue Status Validation
routing.description: Verify the queue is active and properly configured
routing.how_to_check: Admin Portal > Contact Center > Queues > [Queue Name] > Status
common_failures: Queue was recently created and not yet active
routing.remediation: Enable the queue by setting status to 'Active'

routing.name: Queue Membership Validation
routing.description: Verify agents are assigned to the queue
routing.how_to_check: Admin Portal > Contact Center > Queues > [Queue Name] > Members
routing.expected_result: At least one agent assigned and showing as available
routing.remediation: Assign agents to the queue and ensure they are set to Available status

routing.name: Routing Rules Configuration
routing.description: Verify routing rules are enabled and correctly configured
routing.how_to_check: Admin Portal > Contact Center > Routing Rules
routing.expected_result: At least one enabled rule matching the scenario with correct target
routing.remediation: Enable relevant rules, verify conditions, and confirm target queues

routing.name: Skills Configuration
routing.description: Verify skills-based routing is properly configured
routing.how_to_check: Admin Portal > Contact Center > Skills + Queue Skill Requirements + Agent Skills
routing.expected_result: Skills defined, assigned to agents, and required by queue match
routing.remediation: Create skills, assign to agents, configure queue requirements appropriately

routing.name: Overflow Configuration
routing.description: Verify overflow settings for queue capacity handling
routing.how_to_check: Admin Portal > Contact Center > Queues > [Queue Name] > Overflow
routing.expected_result: Overflow enabled with valid target and appropriate threshold
common_failures: Target queue invalid or at capacity
routing.remediation: Enable overflow, set reasonable thresholds, configure valid fallback queue

routing.name: Operating Hours
routing.description: Verify queue operating hours are correctly configured
routing.how_to_check: Admin Portal > Contact Center > Queues > [Queue Name] > Hours
routing.expected_result: Operating hours match expected business hours with correct timezone
common_failures: Hours not set for all days
routing.remediation: Configure correct timezone, set hours for each day, review holiday settings

routing.name: Call Flow Configuration
routing.description: Verify call flow routes to correct queue
routing.how_to_check: Admin Portal > Contact Center > Call Flows > [Flow Name]
routing.expected_result: Call flow paths correctly lead to intended queues without dead ends
routing.remediation: Review and correct call flow logic, ensure all paths have valid destinations

licensing.name: Tenant License Verification
licensing.description: Verify tenant has active CCaaS license
licensing.how_to_check: M365 Admin Center > Billing > Licenses > Search 'Contact Center'
licensing.expected_result: CCaaS license present with available seats
licensing.remediation: Purchase/renew CCaaS license, free up seats, or upgrade tier

licensing.name: User License Assignment
licensing.description: Verify user has CCaaS license assigned
licensing.how_to_check: M365 Admin Center > Users > [User] > Licenses and apps
licensing.expected_result: CCaaS license checkbox is selected for the user
licensing.remediation: Assign CCaaS license to user, wait 15-30 minutes, have user re-login

licensing.name: Feature Flag Status
licensing.description: Verify required feature flags are enabled
licensing.how_to_check: CCaaS Admin Portal > Settings > Feature Management
licensing.expected_result: Required feature is listed and toggle is set to Enabled
licensing.remediation: Enable the feature flag, opt-in to preview if needed

licensing.name: License Tier Feature Access
licensing.description: Verify feature is included in license tier
licensing.expected_result: Feature is included in customer's license tier (Standard/Premium/Enterprise)
common_failures: Feature requires Premium, customer has Standard
licensing.remediation: Advise customer on upgrade path or alternative features

licensing.name: User Role Verification
licensing.description: Verify user has required role for feature access
licensing.expected_result: User has the role required to access the feature
common_failures: User has Agent role, needs Supervisor
licensing.remediation: Assign the appropriate role to the user

licensing.name: Regional Feature Availability
licensing.description: Verify feature is available in tenant's region
licensing.how_to_check: Admin Portal > About (for region) + Feature Availability Matrix
licensing.expected_result: Feature is generally available in the tenant's region
common_failures: Feature not yet rolled out to region
licensing.remediation: Provide rollout timeline, suggest alternatives, or discuss tenant migration

connectivity.name: Service Health Status
connectivity.how_to_check: https://status.azure.com + https://status.microsoft.com + Admin Portal > Service Health
connectivity.expected_result: No active incidents affecting CCaaS in customer's region
connectivity.remediation: Inform customer of known outage, provide status page, monitor for resolution

connectivity.name: Firewall Endpoint Access
connectivity.description: Verify required endpoints are accessible through firewall
connectivity.expected_result: All required CCaaS endpoints are accessible on port 443
common_failures: New endpoints not added to allowlist
connectivity.remediation: Provide endpoint list to IT team, request firewall rule updates

connectivity.name: Browser Compatibility
connectivity.how_to_check: Ask user for browser name and version
connectivity.remediation: Update browser, test in incognito mode, try alternative browser

connectivity.name: WebRTC/Media Connectivity
connectivity.how_to_check: Run network connectivity test tool, check UDP 3478-3481
connectivity.expected_result: UDP connectivity confirmed, TURN servers accessible
connectivity.remediation: Open UDP ports, whitelist TURN server IPs, review NAT configuration

connectivity.name: Proxy Configuration
connectivity.description: Verify proxy is not interfering with connections
connectivity.how_to_check: Check browser certificate issuer, ask about proxy/SSL inspection
connectivity.expected_result: Certificate shows Microsoft as issuer, not proxy
connectivity.remediation: Exclude CCaaS domains from SSL inspection, configure proxy for WebSocket

version.name: Current Version Check
version.how_to_check: Admin Portal > About or Settings > System Information
version.expected_result: Version number clearly identified for troubleshooting reference
version.remediation: Note version for issue correlation, check known issues for that version

version.name: Known Issues Check
version.description: Check if issue matches known bugs for the version
version.how_to_check: Search internal Known Issues repository for version + symptoms
version.expected_result: Either no match (new issue) or match found with documented workaround
version.remediation: Apply documented workaround or hotfix, escalate if no solution exists

version.name: Feature Availability by Version
version.description: Verify feature is available in current version
version.how_to_check: Reference Release Notes for current version
version.expected_result: Feature is included in the current version's feature set
version.remediation: Advise on upgrade path or feature alternatives

version.name: Deprecated Parameter Check
version.description: Check for deprecated configurations after upgrade
version.how_to_check: Review upgrade logs, check Admin Portal for warnings
version.remediation: Update configurations to use new parameters, review migration guide

environment.name: Tenant Environment Type
environment.description: Confirm if issue is in Production or Sandbox
environment.remediation: Ensure testing in correct environment, note sandbox limitations

environment.name: Azure Region
environment.description: Verify tenant's Azure region for regional issues
environment.how_to_check: Admin Portal > About > Region or Azure Portal
environment.expected_result: Region identified for service availability correlation
environment.remediation: Check regional feature availability, monitor regional status

environment.name: Compliance/DLP Settings
environment.description: Check for compliance policies affecting functionality
environment.how_to_check: M365 Compliance Center + Azure AD Conditional Access
environment.expected_result: No blocking policies for CCaaS functionality
environment.remediation: Work with compliance team to review and adjust policies
